name: Ground Truth Generation for Neural Marching Cubes
definition: Computes per-grid-cell ground truth (case ID, vertex positions, plane parameters) from high-resolution voxels and surface intersections to train a CNN for predicting Marching Cubes configurations.
summary: Ground Truth Generation for Neural Marching Cubes creates training data by computing per-grid-cell labels from high-resolution voxel and surface intersection data, distinguishing itself by using explicit intersection points for least-squares fitting rather than relying on gradients.
